desc: Monitor soil moisture, temperature, and humidity remotely to enable smart farming decisions!
title: IoT Agriculture Monitoring System
fullDesc: An IoT-based agriculture monitoring system that uses multiple sensors to track soil moisture, ambient temperature, and humidity. Helps farmers make data-driven irrigation and crop management decisions.
author: Tinkering Lab
subtitle: Smart farm monitoring with soil moisture and weather sensors
guide: Connect DHT11 data pin to ESP32 GPIO 4
Connect soil moisture sensor analog output to ESP32
Access web dashboard at ESP32 IP address
